scope: All-target composer/shortcut uncertain enqueue retention and read-only persisted-state consumer invalidation
finding: Queue persistence runs independently of the awaiting enqueue caller. A committed pending row can be independently signalled and physically emitted before that caller observes an enqueue error; that error cannot certify no physical send.
repair: Composer and shortcut enqueue exceptions retain every saved direct, channel or ambiguous row without status/pending/seen writes or saved-key refetch. Missing-row or replacement races cannot mask the original failure or grant identity.

Original errors remain observable. Saved composer errors and typed shortcut EnqueueUnconfirmed categories append explicit localized possible-send and duplicate-retry uncertainty. Creation errors and successful sends are unchanged.

Frozen neutral EntityKey event maps through the app dispatcher without status application. Same-radio timeline uses distinct PersistenceInvalidated and the actual anchored window read, bypassing prepareMessages/reaction indexing/persistence, seen and unread writes. Ordinary history/open/refresh/loadOlder keep their existing behavior.

Same-radio list uses a new neutral kind to request actual conversation/preview/badge reload, including legitimate newly persisted failures. Foreign-radio neutral keys are filtered before list mapping.
Unrelated pre-existing Failed, Resent and status event branches are not reinterpreted.
